Requirements/Salient Characteristics: The following specification lists the minimum requirements for a lock-in amplifier. Objective requirements are also highlighted when available. A lock-in amplifier is crucial for separating laser photodetector outputs from noise that may otherwise drown out the signal. Therefore, this lock-in component is necessary for meeting mission requirements. 3.1. The lock-in amplifier shall meet the following technical requirements: 3.1.1. Demodulation capability for DC up to 600 megahertz or higher reference signals 3.1.2. At least two analog BNC inputs 3.1.3. At least two analog BNC outputs 3.1.4. Analog to digital input conversion capability included, along with the inverse of digital to analog output conversion 3.1.5. Minimum sampling rate for input data of 1.25 giga-samples per second (GSa/s) 3.1.6. USB 2.0 or USB-C interface is supported 3.1.7. PC software interface included 3.1.8. Coding support for either Python or MATLAB languages 3.1.8.1. API for supported language must be given 3.1.9. Come with a manufacturer’s warranty of at least 1 year 3.1.10.
